Maria: quick status check — cut window at 17:00 PT. Canary health looks green overall but we've got three cherry-picks pending: PR #4581, #4590, #4592. One of them is blocked by a CI flake. Any blockers?

Dave: saw a p95 latency blip ~16:20. dashboards.redwood/inference/canary — looking into a hotspot on tokenizer service. not a hard fail but monitoring.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary-deploy train-2167 started at 2026-03-17T16:00Z — initial checks passed :white_check_mark:

Lee: I'm on PR #4590 — failing integration `kv-cache-evict` test. re-running CI now. if flakes persist i'll bisect.

Anya: I can take 4581 backport and rebase. ping me with the target branch and I’ll push a patch today.

Raj: SRE flagged one GPU eviction on node g4-12 at 15:58, rebooted, metrics look stable now. still watching.

Maria: thanks — Lee, keep us posted on CI. Anya, assign 4581 to yourself and add the backport label. If canary is green at 16:50 we'll proceed with cut; otherwise hold and do another quick smoke.

Lee: re-run succeeded, tests green locally too. pushed a fix for a race. PR #4590 -> ready for merge.

Anya: assigned and opened backport PR 4599 -> targets/v1.2. added changelog note.

Dave: latency blip traced to tokenizer cache warming; adding a short warmup in the canary job to smooth p95. will push in 10m.

Maria: perfect. if anyone sees a regression during the next canary run @maria please call timeout and we’ll hold. :thumbsup:
